utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around school drop-off and pickup times, but I’ll need the repair drive schedule first.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’ll grab the schedule and bring it by after errands, Faye.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Thanks, Ira — bring it by when you can, and I’ll work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — I’ll take a quick look and see what I can help with.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. Let me know what you find, and I’ll keep the list updated.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Will do — I’ll check it out and report back soon.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help work around the school schedule—what time is the repair drive, and what do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Thanks, Faye — it starts at 10 and goes until noon, and I could use your help sorting donations and handing out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: That should work for me — I can be there at 10 and help sort donations and hand out screwdrivers.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I can help, but I’d like to know the timing and what needs hauling before I commit.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Sure — I’ll check the timing and list what needs hauling, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik. Just let me know as soon as you have it, and I’ll see if I can make it work.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, the repair drive? I heard about it—I'm telling everyone to come by and lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Quinn. I’ll stop by and see what needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great, Rey — I’ll keep spreading the word, and I’m sure folks will appreciate the help.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help keep folks in the loop about the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Jules — could you share the repair drive location and the best way to get there?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — it’s at the community shed on Maple Lane, just past the playground. Easiest way is to head in from Oak Street and follow the signs.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help bring folks together for the repair drive—want me to reach out to a couple of people I know?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Maybe—who exactly are you planning to contact?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can check in with the folks who usually help with tools and supplies, plus a couple of handy neighbors who’ve volunteered before. If you want, I can keep it to just a small list.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Could you share the repair drive details again, just so I make sure I’ve got everything right?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sure — it’s this Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center. Bring any broken small appliances or tools, and we’ll try to fix what we can.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, that helps — Saturday from 10 to 2 at the community center, and I should bring broken small appliances or tools. Did you want me to mention this to anyone else?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard there’s a repair drive going on—what do they still need help with?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Mostly hands-on help and a few tools, I think—best to check the sign by the hall.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Got it—I’ll check the sign by the hall. Thanks for the heads-up.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing, Hana — I can lend a hand with tools for the repair drive. Just let me know what you need.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Gus — I’ll check the list and let you know exactly what tools we still need.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sounds good — I’ll keep my toolbox ready and set those aside once you send the list.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, I’ve heard the repair drive is picking up nicely — folks are dropping off all kinds of useful things. If you’re heading over, I can tell you what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That’d be kind, Tess. I can swing by if there’s something they still need.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: They could still use a few hand tools, some sturdy boxes, and any spare tarps people can part with.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I meant to look at that. What changed?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I don’t have the new details yet—just that something changed with the repair drive. I’ll check the location info and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Okay, thanks—just let me know when you’ve got it. I might’ve missed the update too.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: So, Oren, what’s the repair drive focusing on first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: I think the biggest things are the leaky faucet and that loose front-step rail — unless I’m mixing up the list again. We should check what’s most urgent first.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it—let’s check the list and start with whatever’s most urgent. Do you want to handle the faucet first or the front-step rail?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s wonderful, Rey — thank you. Could you help by checking in with a few neighbors and seeing who needs repairs or supplies?

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course — I’ll check in with a few neighbors and see who needs repairs or supplies. I’ll let you know what I find.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, thank you, Sam! Could you help spread the word and maybe collect a few donations or tools if folks have extras?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I can spread the word and ask around for any spare donations or tools. Just tell me where you want me to start.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Eli, sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: No worries, Dane — I’ve got it sorted so far. I’m keeping to the plan and can fill you in when you’re ready.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Glad to hear it — give me the quick version when you can, and I’ll jump in where needed.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can bring the extra tape and a few spare screws for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Cleo — that’ll help a lot. I’ll probably swing by a bit late, but I’ll bring what I can too.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: No worries — I’ll set the tape and screws aside for you. See you there, Dane.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — I can help with the repair drive. What do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Thanks, Leo — if you can bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, and any spare screws you’ve got, that’d be a huge help.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Absolutely — I’ll bring a hammer, a screwdriver set, and whatever spare screws I can find.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little, but I need to keep things low-key right now.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, of course — low-key is good. I’ll keep it quiet and just let you know the basics.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. Just send me the basics when you have them, and I’ll do what I can.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Absolutely — I’m in for the repair drive. Tell me what you need me to do first.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Great, thanks, Mara. I’ll send you the first couple of things to grab as soon as I sort my notes.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I’ll keep an eye out for your note and get started as soon as you send it.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Vik—just tell me what needs fixing and what time you want to start. If we keep it simple and on schedule, I’m in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great — let’s keep it simple and start at 10 tomorrow morning. I’ll send over the fixes we need and we can go one by one.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good to me, Vik. I’ll be ready at 10 tomorrow and we can go through the fixes one by one.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening today, right?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Yep, still on for today.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, thanks for confirming.
